import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODX1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MODX2 = 1000000007L;

    static long cnt = 0;
    static long nVal;
    static long lowVal = 0;
    static long ans = 0;
    static long[] pwx = new long[8];
    static List<Integer>[] numArr = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            numArr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void dfs_generate(int d, int x) {
        int t = (int)((cnt + MODX1 - x) % MODX1);
        numArr[d].add(t);
        lowVal = (lowVal + t) % MODX2;
        cnt++;
        if (d < 6) {
            for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                dfs_generate(d + 1, x * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfs_process(int d, long x) {
        if (x > nVal) return;
        int i;
        if (x * pwx[6] + pwx[6] - 1 <= nVal && x * pwx[7] > nVal) {
            for (i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long delta = (cnt + (MODX1 - pwx[i]) * x) % MODX1;
                int idx = lowerBound(numArr[i], (int)(MODX1 - delta));
                ans = (ans + ((delta + MODX2 - MODX1) % MODX2) * pwx[i] + MODX1 * idx) % MODX2;
            }
            ans = (ans + lowVal) % MODX2;
            cnt += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        ans = (ans + (cnt + MODX1 - x % MODX1) % MODX1) % MODX2;
        cnt++;
        int startDigit = d != 0 ? 0 : 1;
        for (i = startDigit; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs_process(d + 1, x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        pwx[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
            pwx[i] = pwx[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        dfs_generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(numArr[i]);
        }
        nVal = sc.nextLong();
        cnt = 0;
        ans = 0;
        dfs_process(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
